rca of the issue: UI checkbox defect root cause is CSS selector scope in frontend styles: generic input sizing rule in layer properties includes checkbox inputs, inflating '[data-testid="text-shadow-enabled"]' to text-input dimensions. Repro: open /gestalten, select text layer, view Gravureffekte; computed checkbox size ~190x41 instead of 16x16. Mitigation: narrow generic input selector to exclude type=checkbox (and likely type=range/color) or add stronger specific rule for .effect-switch input[type=checkbox].
